listing.name: Furry Sector - A complete portrait replacement pack w/ mod support
listing.summary: A complete portrait replacement mod that replaces vanilla portraits and portraits of some mods. Portraits made using Indigo Furry Mix XL
listing.aiSummary: Replaces vanilla and modded character portraits with furry animal portraits.

description:
Tired of seeing boring humans in your sector?

Confurt your sector today!

A complete portrait replacement mod that replaces vanilla portraits and portraits of some mods.
Portraits made using Indigo Furry Mix XL
Character fursonas are randomly assigned for the most part, though there are a few specially assigned ones i felt fitting.

Potentially Asked Questions

Spoiler
Compatibility?

Safe to add/remove mid game
Will never be incompatible with any mod ever (unless the portrait system is changed). The worst that can happen is the original portrait being used

Vram Impact?
None afaik. Though portraits are present on disk, they will only be loaded if a specific mod looks for them while loading. Since it's a replacement it should not affect vram usage.

Can you convert X mod?
Only if I'm playing with it

This ruins my immersion!
You lack whimsy.

Furries? In MY sector?
It's more likely than you'd think!

Are you a furry?
Perchance
